interface.title: SEM analyzer v1.0.0 (Korean-language Streamlit app by JongJin Chung)
interface.field: Electron microscopy / materials and particle characterisation
interface.stage_of_work: Image analysis and preparing figures for publication
interface.what_it_is_for: Set the scale of SEM micrographs, measure lengths and diameters on them into a table, crop off the instrument data bar, add a scale bar, panel letter and text, and export annotated PNGs, a CSV of measurements and montage figures.

data.note: Used cell-brightfield.png, a brightfield cell image with no scale bar or Hitachi .txt sidecar. I calibrated it by hand: a line about 200 screen px long entered as 10 µm, which gave 50 nm/px (20 px/µm). That number is made up, so the µm values only show that the tool works; they are not real sizes. Uploading the same file a second time was de-duplicated to 1 image and also cleared the calibration.

tree.specific: Calibrate an SEM image, measure with lines and circles, crop the data bar, add a scale bar, panel label and text box, export PNG and CSV, and build a Figures montage

features.name: Two-point scale calibration on an image
features.general: Enter the real length of a reference feature, draw a line over it on the image, and turn that into a pixel size that every later measurement uses
features.specific: 수동 보정: type 스케일바 실제 길이 (µm), draw on the calibration canvas, press 이 선으로 보정; the status reads 보정됨 x nm/px (y px/µm). The alternative is 자동 보정 from a Hitachi .txt sidecar, which shows an error when there is none
steps: open the manual calibration panel
type the known length in µm
draw a line over the reference feature
press calibrate and read the nm/px status
optional: try auto calibration, which needs metadata
serves_tasks: Calibrate by drawing over a feature of known length

features.name: Measurement canvas with a live results table
features.general: Draw lines or circles on an image; each shape is converted to physical units, labelled on the image and added as a row to a table, and moving or resizing a shape recalculates its value
features.specific: 그리기 모드 직선/원/자유/선택·편집 with 선 색 (line colour), 굵기 (thickness), 길이/지름 표시 (show length/diameter); 측정 결과 table (#, 유형, 값(µm), 표시); 마지막 개체 삭제 (delete last). 전체 삭제 (delete all), Ctrl+Z and the Delete key are offered but were not tried
steps: pick line or circle mode
drag on the image to measure; a label and a table row appear
repeat for more features
switch to select/edit, then move or resize a shape and the value updates
delete the last shape if it was a mistake
serves_tasks: Measure a length with a line
Measure a diameter with a circle
Adjust an existing measurement and have the value update

features.name: Figure overlays: scale bar, panel letter, text boxes
features.general: On a calibrated image, draw a scale bar at a chosen length and corner, add a panel letter and free text boxes, and see the result in a preview that matches the export
features.specific: 3. 논문 Fig 요소: 스케일바 자동 그리기 (length, 위치, 색, 굵기, 글자 크기, 길이 글자 표시); 패널 라벨 (text, position, size, colour, 배경 박스); 텍스트 박스 (내용, x/y %, size, colour, 배경 박스, ➕ 추가); shown in the 5. 출력 preview. The scale-bar overlay is reused in the Figures montage
steps: set the scale bar length and corner
type a panel label and pick its corner
type a text box, set its position, colour and background, press add
check the output preview

features.name: Data-bar crop
features.general: Trim a fixed-height strip off the bottom of a micrograph so the instrument's data bar does not appear in the figure
features.specific: 2. 크롭: tick 하단 정보바 잘라내기 and set 자를 높이 (px) (defaulted to 0 on this image); the 5. 출력 preview gets shorter
steps: tick the bottom-strip crop
set the crop height in px
check that the output preview is shorter
serves_tasks: Cut the instrument data bar off the bottom

features.name: Annotated image and measurement export
features.general: Name the project and download the annotated image and a CSV of the measurement table under the same name
features.specific: 프로젝트 이름 / 저장 파일명 (project name / save filename) give the file stem (project_image); ⬇️ PNG 다운로드 and ⬇️ 측정값 CSV
steps: type a project name
download the annotated PNG
download the measurements CSV
serves_tasks: Name the output and download the annotated image and the measurement table

features.name: Montage figure builder
features.general: Pick images in order, arrange them in a grid with a set gap, cell width and background, add a letter to each panel and a scale bar to each panel (each image's own length or one shared length), then export the combined figure and the processed panels
features.specific: 🔲 Figures view: click thumbnails in the sidebar to set 배치 순서 (panel order); 한 행 칸 수, 간격, 배경색 (background colour), 셀 너비, 정보바 크롭 (crop info bar), 스케일바, 패널 라벨 a,b,c… with 위치, 원본 스케일바 크기 or 공통 길이 µm, 스케일바 위치/색/굵기 (scale bar position/colour/thickness); ⬇️ Figure PNG and ⬇️ 개별 가공본 ZIP. Uncalibrated images get a warning and no scale bar. Partial: only a single uncalibrated panel was shown, so no multi-panel grid and no per-panel scale bar were seen
steps: switch to the Figures view
click thumbnails to add panels in order
set columns, gap and cell width
choose the panel label position and the scale bar mode
download the figure PNG or the per-panel ZIP
serves_tasks: Pick images for a montage and lay them out
Export the montage and the processed panels
